notes: Fixes the v6.0.20 multimeter connection regressions a tester hit: the app no longer holds a sleeping meter hostage over USB (which made it vanish from the port picker), the reconnect loop now verifies the meter answers before committing and fully releases everything when it gives up, a connected-but-silent meter now fails with a clear message ('No response — check AUTO-OFF') instead of sitting on DISCONNECT forever, and a found bug that could freeze the whole read loop when a port dropped is fixed. Port picker: the filter now actually applies (v6.0.20 shipped it computed-but-unused) and identical duplicate entries collapse to one button.
